Debrief DB-021
1) The actor disconnected water service to the affected units; utility shutdown logs were left behind; habitability verification was skipped.
2) The actor replaced door locks on occupied tenancies; old key and lock inventory records were left behind; tenant consent verification was skipped.
3) The actor posted notices containing coercive language; dated notice copies were left behind; legal review of notice content was skipped.
4) The actor removed heat and sanitation access from the premises; maintenance work orders were left behind; occupancy status check was skipped.
5) The actor delayed and rerouted inspection requests; internal routing logs were left behind; mandatory inspection compliance was skipped.
